## Page 2

classification Softmax Function

$$
\sigma(\vec{a})_i = \frac{\exp(a_i)}{\sum_{j=1}^{k} \exp(a_j)}
$$

*[Editorial note: the subscript inside the denominator's $\exp(\cdot)$ is hard to
read; it could be $a_i$ or $a_j$. The sum runs over $j$, so $a_j$ is the sensible
reading.]*

outputs sum to 1

can be viewed as probabilites.

---

Activation Functions.

Sigmoid: $\quad \sigma(x) = \dfrac{1}{1 + \exp(-x)}$

Tanh: $\quad \tanh(x) = \dfrac{\exp(x) - \exp(-x)}{\exp(x) + \exp(-x)}$

Linear : $\quad f(x) = kx.$

Step function:

*[Editorial note — figure: a small plot with the vertical axis marked $1$ (top)
and $0$ (bottom). The curve runs flat along $0$, jumps straight up to $1$ a little
right of the middle of the box, and stays flat at $1$.]*

Logic Threshold Function:

*[Editorial note — figure: a small plot with the vertical axis marked $4$ (top),
$0$ (middle, with a dashed horizontal line), and $-4$ (bottom). The curve is flat
at $-4$ on the left, rises as a straight ramp through the middle, and is flat
(slightly rising) at $4$ on the right. No formula is written.]*

## Page 3

Softmax activation function.

$$
S(x_i) = \frac{\exp(x_i)}{\sum_{j=1}^{k} \exp(x_j)}
$$

---

ReLU Activation Function

$$
\text{ReLU}(x) = \begin{cases} 0 & (x < 0) \\ x & (x \geq 0) \end{cases}
$$

*[Editorial note — figure: a plot with $0$ marked on the vertical axis; the curve
is flat at $0$ on the left, then a straight ramp up to the right.]*

---

Leaky ReLU

$$
\text{Leaky ReLU}(x) = \begin{cases} c \cdot x & (x < 0) \\ x & (x \geq 0) \end{cases}
$$

~~Leaky ReLU(x)~~ -

*[Editorial note — figure: a plot with $0$ marked on the vertical axis (a dot on
the axis at $0$). The curve rises with a small slope on the left — passing just
below the $0$ level — to a kink, then rises steeply on the right.]*

---

ELU: $\quad$ ELU$(x) = \begin{cases} \alpha \cdot (\exp(x) - 1) & (x < 0) \\ x & (x \geq 0) \end{cases}$

---

GELU.

$$
\text{GELU}(x) = x \cdot \phi(x). \quad \big(\, \phi(x) = 0.5\,(1 + \operatorname{erf}(x/\sqrt{2}))\,\big)
$$

*[Editorial note: written with a lowercase-looking $\phi$. The function
$0.5\,(1 + \operatorname{erf}(x/\sqrt2))$ is the standard normal **CDF**, usually
written with a capital $\Phi$; lowercase $\varphi$ normally denotes the density.]*
